summary: Lookup plugins pull data from external stores for loops (with_* constructs) and values, must always return lists, and authors should decide how much filtering to do inside the plugin.
questions: What should a lookup plugin return?
How are with_items and with_fileglob implemented?
Should I filter data inside my lookup or in the playbook?

answer_card.title: Lookup plugin basics
answer_card.answer_md: Lookups pull data from external sources, both for loops (`with_fileglob`, `with_items` are lookups) and for values. They must **return a list**, even for one item. Decide whether to filter inside the plugin or leave it to playbook filters based on how the data will be used.
